integrity: Original map, invariant lines and qualitative global convergence are attributed to prior work; this claim concerns finite-generation joint critical-layer scaling only. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed coefficients strictly between zero and one and independent uniform initial coordinates only.
Vague convergence against compactly supported tests; no global total-variation convergence or parameter-uniformity.
Potential unindexed equivalences in general parabolic-map scaling and random initial-ensemble limits remain a priority risk.
title: A universal rare-event curve at the critical corner of a bisexual quadratic map
